name: parametric-kitchen-journey
description: Full journey for C270 kitchen-run type: Simple/Pro flag gate, dialog controls (dimensions + bay count + uppers + bay-style picker), live-preview updates, drawers+doors mixed config, add-to-room saves GLB + arms placement, mobile viewport leg.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-kitchen-flag-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const flags = window.__store.getState().featureFlags; if (!flags.kitchenCabinets) throw new Error('kitchenCabinets flag is OFF in Simple — expected ON (tier: simple)'); if (!flags.parametricFurniture) throw new Error('parametricFurniture is OFF in Simple — expected ON (tier: simple)'); })()

steps.name: kitchen-tab-in-simple
steps.failMessage: Kitchen run tab not visible in Simple mode (kitchenCabinets is simple-tier)

steps.name: toggle-uppers
steps.eval: (function(){ const toggle = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Upper cabinets"]'); if (!toggle) throw new Error('Upper cabinets toggle not found'); toggle.click(); })()

steps.name: set-bay1-drawer
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Bay 1:"]')); const drawerBtn = btns.find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Bay 1: Drawer'); if (!drawerBtn) throw new Error('Bay 1 Drawer button not found'); drawerBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: set-bay2-open
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Bay 2:"]')); const openBtn = btns.find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Bay 2: Open'); if (!openBtn) throw new Error('Bay 2 Open button not found'); openBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: add-to-room
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const addBtn = btns.find(b => b.textContent && b.textContent.trim() === 'Add to room'); if (!addBtn) throw new Error('Add to room button not found'); addBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-item-in-scene
steps.eval: (function(){ const items = window.__store.getState().items; if (!items || items.length === 0) throw new Error('No items in scene after add-to-room'); })()
